newsitem.title: USA: U.S. TREASURY 30-YR BOND YIELD SEEN AT 6.45-46 PCT.
newsitem.headline: U.S. TREASURY 30-YR BOND YIELD SEEN AT 6.45-46 PCT.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury's sale of $10.0 billion in 30-year bonds on Thursday was expected to produce a yield 6.45 to 6.46 percent, market participants said.
In when-issued trade at about 1240 EDT/1640 GMT, the 10-year note was bid at 6.4425 percent.
The bidding deadline for the auction is 1300 EDT/1700 GMT. Results are expected around 1345 EDT/1745 GMT.
